# dtcloud_vm_history_entry (Data Source)

Reads one virtual machine history entry in full.

The list endpoint leaves out `status`; this is the only way to get it. That is also why this is a separate data source rather than the list fetching details for every entry, which would be one call per entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_vm_history_entry" "resize" {
  vm_id      = dtcloud_vm.web.id
  history_id = data.dtcloud_vm_history.web.entries[0].history_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `history_id` (String) ID of the entry, from dtcloud_vm_history.
- `vm_id` (String) ID of the virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `activity` (String) What was done.
- `date_and_time` (String) When it happened.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `initiator` (String) Who or what did it.
- `status` (String) Outcome of the action. Reported only by this endpoint, not by the list.
